meaning:
φείδομαι
[in LXX for חָמַל, חוּס, חָשַׂךְ, etc. ;]
to spare: 2Co.13:2; with genitive of person(s), Act.20:29, Rom.8:32 11:21, 1Co.7:28, 2Co.1:23, 2Pe.2:4-5; with inf., to forbear, 2Co.12:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.
For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
